features.title: Start/Select Mapping

features.title: Rendering and Layout Fixes
features.subtitle: Fixed Mupen and Mednafen resolution issues and corrected several screen placement bugs.

features.title: Controller Skin Improvements
features.subtitle: Improved controller skin performance and expanded supported layouts.

features.title: GenesisPlusGX CHD Support
features.subtitle: Added CHD support to GenesisPlusGX for improved disc-based library compatibility.

features.title: Pause Menu Refresh
features.subtitle: Improved pause menu design with new features and a more polished experience.

features.title: New Pause Menu
features.subtitle: A redesigned tile-based pause menu gives you quick access to saves, cheats, shaders, and settings — all from a floating overlay that keeps your game in view.

features.title: Cheat Code Library
features.subtitle: Search over 1.2 million cheat codes covering 44 systems. Online lookup from GameHacking.org and GeckoCodes included.

features.title: Advanced Skin Features
features.subtitle: Animated backgrounds, per-button haptics, multi-theme variants, animated button sprites, and PDF rendering. Enable via Settings > Feature Flags.

features.title: CRT Shader Controls
features.subtitle: Adjust CRT shader parameters directly from the pause menu — curvature, scanlines, bloom, and more.

features.title: Haptic Feedback & Rumble
features.subtitle: Controller rumble support with configurable intensity. On-screen buttons now have haptic feedback with custom per-system profiles.

features.title: DualSense & DS4 Enhancements
features.subtitle: Light bars glow with per-system colors. Mic button mutes audio. Touchpad click and Share/Create buttons are now fully bindable.

features.title: Lock Screen & StandBy Widgets
features.subtitle: Quick Launch lock screen widgets jump straight into your last-played game. StandBy shows rotating box art and now-playing info.

features.title: Core Language Sync
features.subtitle: Emulator cores now default to your device language. Override globally under Settings → Core Options → Core Language.

features.title: JIT Detection & Status
features.subtitle: Smart JIT indicator shows the active source (AltStore, TrollStore, etc.) for cores that need it. Auto-hides after 5 seconds.

features.title: Smart Auto-Pause
features.subtitle: Game pauses automatically when AirPods or Bluetooth headphones disconnect.

features.title: In-Game Toast Notifications
features.subtitle: Save states, JIT status, and controller events appear as unobtrusive overlays. OSD messages bridged for all 60+ RetroArch cores.

features.title: Spotlight & Siri Shortcuts
features.subtitle: Games are indexed in Spotlight on import. Ask Siri to launch any game by name — no Shortcuts setup required.

features.title: USB HID Peripheral Support
features.subtitle: Connect USB gamepads, steering wheels, memory card readers, and more via the Provenance Companion app.

features.title: DriverKit Extension
features.subtitle: The Companion app hosts a DriverKit system extension that enables devices not natively supported by iPadOS — including DualShock 3 and GameCube adapters.

features.title: System-Wide Drivers
features.subtitle: Once activated, Provenance drivers work for every emulator and game on your iPad — not just Provenance.

features.title: Driver Store
features.subtitle: Unlock premium driver packs — DualShock 3, GameCube adapter, steering wheels, and more — with one-time in-app purchases.

features.title: Export Battery Save
features.subtitle: Long-press any game to export its SRAM/battery save file — compatible with Delta, RetroArch, PPSSPP, and other emulators.

features.title: Import Battery Save
features.subtitle: Bring in a .sav/.srm/.ram file from any emulator. Paired RTC clock files are imported automatically.

features.title: Import from Other Emulators
features.subtitle: New step-by-step guide to migrate your saves from Delta, RetroArch, Mantic Emu, PPSSPP, and Gamma. Find it in Settings → Library.

features.title: Automatic Detection
features.subtitle: Provenance now detects which emulators are installed and surfaces tailored export instructions for each one.

features.title: Manual Import Guide
features.subtitle: Not migrating from a specific app? A general guide covers .sav/.srm/.state imports via Files.app and the built-in web server.
